components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button with BUMN Blue gradient and subtle border.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(to right, #0b4596, #1d4ed8); color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(to right, #2563eb, #1e40af); transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action control with dark slate background.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0f172a; color: #e2e8f0; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #1e293b; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1e293b; border-color: #334155; color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: The Sovereign Lighthouse represents structured corporate authority, utilizing a deep navy canvas, stark white typography, and gold accentuation to guide Indonesian enterprises through GRC and regulatory compliance. The design system is constructed to evoke immediate trust and stability, critical for State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN) and financial sector institutions.
keyCharacteristics: Sovereign Dark Canvas: A stable, high-contrast dark color palette.
Structured Geometry: Rectilinear layouts and thin sub-pixel boundaries.
Executive Focus: Deliberate accents that guide attention.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: BUMN Gold must cover no more than 10% of any single viewport surface.

rules.name: The No-Fad-Neutrals Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds must never transition into warm neutral creams or grays.

rules.name: The Balancer Rule
rules.body: All h1, h2, and h3 headings must utilize text-wrap: balance.

rules.name: The Prose Cap Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs must have a max-width of max-w-2xl or 75ch.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Rest Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements remain flat at rest; shadows are dynamic.

dos: Do maintain a minimum of 4.5:1 color contrast for all body text.
Do wrap long headers in text-wrap: balance.
Do use BUMN Gold selectively for critical scores and achievements.
donts: Don't use standard SaaS clichés (no cream/sand warm backgrounds).
Don't use amateurish styling (no sketch illustrations or over-rounded cards).
Don't use typical hacker/cyberpunk dark mode overrides.
